name: Bonescythe Digs
label: Quest
description: Bonescythe Digs: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Don Julio's Bonescythe armor pattern requires bone fragments - a lot of bone fragments. While those crazy enough to venture into Naxxramas provide me with enough of the core materials to make the armor, I'm always looking for more Scourge bone fragments.
So what do you think? Interested in getting your hands dirty and destroying some Scourge at the same time? It's a win-win situation.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can direct you to skeleton infested locales, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You work fast, friend. Fast like a fox... Say, have I ever told you about the time I was in a barber shop quartet?
Remind me to tell you that story one of these days.
